Subject: Cross-border exec workshop — initial availability ask

Hi Akira / Maya,

Thanks again for the conversation last week — excited to align on the in-person + virtual executive workshop you want to run across Tokyo, London and SF leadership. To get operations lined up (travel, room blocks, AV runbook) we need to lock attendance windows from your side. Can you confirm the following high-level constraints by end of next week?

- Target week windows (we assume 2 full workshop days + 1 optional prep/rehearsal day)
- Preferred time-of-day anchor (APAC-morning / EMEA-afternoon / US-morning) or constraints for key execs
- Any travel embargoes or site access requirements (visitor badges, escorts, NDA needed)
- Local POCs for logistics in Tokyo and London

To speed this up, we can hold provisional calendar slots that map to three candidate 2-hour executive alignment blocks across time zones. If you share names of the 6–8 execs who must attend live, we’ll provide options that minimize overlap and propose a hybrid AV setup.

I’ve copied Karthik to coordinate the technical runbook and Maya for prospective site specifics. We’ll draft an availability matrix and site-access checklist once you confirm constraints.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Head, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Neha — thanks for the clear ask. A few quick notes from our side:

- Target week: we prefer the week of Jan 18, 2027 (avoid Jan 11 due to quarterly close)
- Anchor: Tokyo execs prefer morning JST (09:00–11:00 JST) and London prefers late morning GMT (10:00–12:00 GMT); overlap windows are tight — we need a 90–120 minute shared slot between 16:00–18:00 JST / 08:00–10:00 GMT to include SF in their early morning
- Travel: all non-Japan attendees will need site visitor badges; Tokyo campus requires escort after 5pm
- Local POC: Aya Nakamura (aya.nakamura@novus-med.com) for Tokyo; Ben Carter (ben.carter@novus-med.com) for London site ops

Also, a quick heads-up: two of our execs are on a constrained travel policy — they prefer to join virtually for day 2 if flights are tight.

If you can send an availability matrix that overlays JST/GMT/PST slots, that will make it easier to confirm.

—Akira
